game.name: Rapala For Kinect (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Rapala for Kinect is a fishing simulation that can only be played with the Kinect sensor of the Xbox 360. Using various baits, the player must catch around thirty fish in various environments. He will have to make precise gestures to cast his line, hook his prey and try to bring them back on board his boat. Alone or in pairs, you can take part in numerous tournaments and also compete in boat races to get equipment bonuses.
